description: Crafting and refinement recipes. Filled by the cycle 2 bridge prefab dump. UNVALIDATED NESTED SHAPE: validate_table checks only that ingredients and station_guids are lists; the described per-entry objects with prefab_guid and amount are documented but never checked by it. core/table_deep.py promotes both into assertions. schema_version 2 replaced the singular station_guid with the plural station_guids on measurement (ADR-006): nothing on a recipe entity names a station, and the reverse link is one-to-many - 35 WorkstationRecipesBuffer prefabs hold 693 recipe references and 23 RefinementstationRecipesBuffer prefabs hold 249, which is 942 references over 663 recipes.

prefab_guid.description: Stable in-game PrefabGUID hash of the recipe.

station_guids.description: PrefabGUIDs of every station that can run this recipe, sorted ascending. Inverted by the dumper from WorkstationRecipesBuffer and RefinementstationRecipesBuffer, which are the only forward links that exist (ADR-006). An EMPTY array means measured and reachable from no station, which is real for AlwaysUnlocked player-crafted recipes; an ABSENT field means the inversion did not run. The two are deliberately distinguishable. Entries are integers.

craft_duration.description: Seconds per craft at base speed.
